root_text: #Nilgiris district collector, Lakshmi Bhavya Tanneeru, said that the district administration had not imposed any restriction on tourists travelling to the Nilgiris, after recent confirmed cases of #HMPV in Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka.
